test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Either my sisters or __my brother are coming__ to the meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is **"my brother is coming". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence contains a subject-verb agreement error.
 
• The correct verb form should agree with the nearest subject when using **"either...or" **in a sentence.
 
• Since **"my brother" **is singular and is the nearest subject to the verb **"are coming," **the verb should also be singular.
 
• Therefore, the sentence should correctly use **"is coming" **to agree with the singular subject **"my brother."**
 
• Option 3 ("my brother is coming") correctly substitutes the underlined segment with a form that corrects the subject-verb agreement error.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 ("my brother come")** does not provide the correct verb tense or agreement.
 
• **Option 2 ("my brothers is coming") **introduces a plural subject "brothers" which doesn't match the original sentence that refers to a singular "brother," and also incorrectly uses "is" with a plural subject.
 
• **Option 4 ("my brother do not come") **uses an incorrect verb form and negation, significantly changing the meaning of the original sentence.
